sentences.en: The usual signs of infection (e.g. pyrexia, leucocytosis) may be absent and infection surveillance must be rigorous.

sentences.en: It is common for dialysis to precipitate pyrexia in apparently healthy patients in these circumstances.

sentences.en: The MEFV gene carries the instructions for production of a protein called pyrin, named for pyrexia, a medical term for fever.

sentences.en: For example, in patients with severe lung disease a pyrexia or high carbohydrate diet may result in respiratory acidosis.
